planetscale.billing_price_note: Per the official Cloudflare page, Cloudflare-billed PlanetScale uses the same prices as buying from PlanetScale directly.

provisioning_paths.dashboard: Cloudflare dashboard can provision a PlanetScale database billed to the Cloudflare account.
provisioning_paths.cli: `wrangler hyperdrive planetscale signature` only prints a credential-like billing authorization; the database is created by `pscale database create --org <org> --engine postgresql --cloudflare-billing @-` reading it from stdin. That needs an authenticated pscale organization and pscale CLI >= 0.313.0; run pscale with the process-scoped DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/dev/null. A Cloudflare API token alone does not create the database.

pscale_auth_observed.source: root check 2026-09-24: `DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/dev/null pscale auth check --format json` returned authenticated true (oauth) through pscale's documented file fallback when no desktop keyring is reachable; sole org ted-ted-h; database list empty. The earlier TOKEN_SAVE_FAILED was resolved by root. The override is process-scoped only (no global environment/config change); tools never start a login and never read stored credentials.

tls.detail: OCI PostgreSQL presents a certificate from an OCI private CA. Workers VPC does not support a custom CA; a Tunnel public hostname does not match the OCI certificate SAN and there is no SNI override. A cloudflared connector alone does not prove verified end-to-end TLS; PgBouncer double-TLS or another verified path must be validated later.
